<meta>continues from previous page: ...firmly</meta> holds the mind. He makes perfect aspirational prayers. He generates faith so that virtuous qualities not yet arisen may arise. He exerts himself. He initiates diligence. He firmly holds the mind. He makes pure aspirational prayers. He generates faith so that virtuous qualities already arisen may remain, not decline, increase, grow even further, and so that they may be cultivated and perfected. He exerts himself and initiates diligence. He firmly holds the mind. He makes these perfect aspirational prayers.

He fully cultivates the <term>riddhi-pada</term> <gloss>base of miraculous power</gloss> of the <term>samadhi</term> <gloss>meditative concentration</gloss> of intention, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandonment, and which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the base of miraculous power of the meditative concentration of diligence, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandonment, and which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the base of miraculous power of the meditative concentration of the mind, which is endowed with the formative activity of abandonment, and which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

The meditative concentration of discernment...

<leaf-break/>

...fully cultivates the power of diligence, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the power of mindfulness, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the power of meditative concentration, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the power of wisdom, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the limb of perfect enlightenment of mindfulness, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the limb of perfect enlightenment of the discrimination of phenomena, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation, and is perfected through total relinquishment.

He fully cultivates the limb of perfect enlightenment of diligence, which dwells in solitude, dwells in dispassion, dwells in cessation...

<summary>This page details the cultivation of the thirty-seven factors of enlightenment, specifically focusing on the four bases of miraculous power, the five powers, and the seven limbs of enlightenment. Each factor is practiced through the fourfold framework of solitude, dispassion, cessation, and relinquishment.</summary>
